skills.use_when: Verify whether a Jira user's sprint tickets in chosen board column(s) such as Release Pending are actually released to production via Git ancestry and app-interface refs, and close only explicitly approved verified tickets.

Prepare a production deployment through app-interface by checking the requested commit's Quay images, updating all applicable CRCP/HCCP refs together on a clean branch, and opening one GitLab MR without merging it.
